summary: Short kerb beside a park and church at a junction; house 15 m across.

best_section.where: West kerb of Ninth Avenue beside the grassy park, just south of the junction by Christ Church

drivers.seclusion: Park behind, church 13 m away (non-residential); nearest house 15 m across the road, others 25 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed street beside a park; room for one van, but no parked cars seen on this length.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street, close to a junction with a busier road.
drivers.convention: Cars park further along the street, but 3P resident-permit signs apply on weekdays.

flags: Short stretch at a junction mouth
sun_shade: Open grass to the west; trees shade the junction side in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the junction clearance rule limits stopping here
